hooks.name: Usage log on task
hooks.description: After each spec task, ask the agent to append a short entry to KIRO_USAGE.md.

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Append a short, concrete entry (2 to 3 sentences) to KIRO_USAGE.md under the most fitting heading: the task number, what Kiro did, anything that went wrong, and what changed because of it. Do not commit.
